acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Placement states: Pending, Active, Met, Complete - All 4 states exist
Visual state indicator on placement card - Status badge with correct color
State transition buttons based on current state - Only valid transitions shown
Pending → Active: Auto on attendance OR manual button - Status changes, start_date set
Active → Met: "Review Met" button (days complete) - review_met_date recorded
Met → Complete: Requires meeting + first day back - Both fields validated
All transitions logged to daep_placement_transitions - Audit trail complete
Invalid transitions rejected with error - Error message shows valid options
TrespassTracker sync on completion - is_daep flag updated
Met status triggers notifications - Parent email, staff notifications (placeholder for Epic 7)

constraints.constraint: Status values MUST be: 'pending', 'active', 'met', 'complete'. The value 'transition' is renamed to 'met' per PO decision 2025-11-29.
Use CSS variables for badge colors: --daep-warning (pending/yellow), --daep-success (active/green), --daep-info (met/blue), gray-100 (complete). NO hardcoded hex values.
RLS policy: tenant_id = get_my_tenant_id(). All server actions use getTenantId() for tenant isolation.
All transitions MUST create audit log via logAuditEvent() AND insert into daep_placement_transitions table.
Invalid transitions return error with message listing valid options (e.g., "Cannot transition from pending to complete. Valid options: active").
Button visibility per role: Pending (Admin, DAEP Staff), Active (Admin, DAEP Staff), Met (Admin only), Complete (Admin only for notes edit).
Story 2-7 MUST be complete before 2-6. Uses calculateDaysInfo().daysRemaining for "Review Met" button enable/disable.

tests.standards: Testing follows project patterns: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation at API boundaries, server action error handling returns { success: false, error: string }. No formal test runner configured yet - manual testing via dev server. Future: consider Vitest for unit tests.
